people.allowed: public figures (actors, athletes, politicians, musicians, authors, scientists, business leaders, spiritual leaders, historical figures) for neutral portraits/event photos.
blocked: identifying a person from an uploaded photo

contentRules: Never invent prices, discounts, statistics, dates, names or quotes that the user did not supply.
Do not reproduce copyrighted characters, logos or brand marks as the main subject; create an original look instead.
Do not put real people's photos into misleading contexts (fake news, fake ads, fake testimonials).
Web photos are third-party property: keep source domain in the job result for attribution.
